title: Fan-in bound for the search circuit
statement: Let $n,m\in\mathbb{N}$, and for each $j\in\mathbb{N}$ let $D_j$ be a Boolean circuit on $n+j$ inputs in which every gate has distinct arguments, every negation gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. Then the circuit with multiple outputs produced by the search construction from $D_0,D_1,\ldots$ after $m$ stages has distinct arguments at every gate, exactly one argument at each negation gate, and at most two arguments at every gate.
hypotheses_covered: Each $D_j$ has distinct arguments at every gate
Each negation gate of $D_j$ has exactly one argument
Each gate of $D_j$ has at most two arguments
